The '''''Mandator II''-class Star Dreadnaught''' was a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] design that served in the centralized [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Characteristics==
The ''Mandator II''-class was a powerful [[Starship/Legends|vessel]]. While [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] like the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]] could stand up to a handful of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]], a [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] like the ''Mandator II''-class could withstand an assault of up to 1,000 Recusants.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /> As such, the vessel carried reactor equipment large enough to force a hull length of 8 kilometers.<ref name="HNNAGD">''[[HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided]]'', science experts of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] made note of the size required for a ship large enough to destroy entire task forces of capital ships, a minimum was a length of 8km.</ref>

==History==
Having cut its ties to the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] prior to the Clone Wars, Kuat Drive Yards began building starships for Republic use only.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Among its new designs was the ''Mandator II''-class, an upgrade of the prewar [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-class Star Dreadnaught]], which had formed part of the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector's]] defenses in peace-time.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
These heavy vessels formed part of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] newly centralized [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Navy during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="SWR">[[Republic 71|''Republic'' 71]], by the end of the story, all home fleets are made part of the centralized Navy.</ref> along with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY's]] other heavily armed, wedge-shaped warship designs.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /><ref name="DBRAC">{{DB|starship|republicattackcruiser|Republic attack cruiser}}</ref>

The class was far larger and more heavily armed than the ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer and was produced in fewer numbers than this common Jedi cruiser.<ref name="OS&VC32">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 32|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 32]]</ref>
The various KDY warships were collectively praised for the Republic's victories during the war, while the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Generals]]' leadership was downplayed.<ref name="ROTS:ICS" /><ref name="DBRAC" /><ref name="SS">''[[Slave Ship]]''</ref>
The ''Mandator II''-class design was later surpassed by heavy warships made during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SOTGSE">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref>

Among the designs derived from it, was the [[Bellator-class dreadnought/Legends|''Bellator''-class dreadnought]] and the [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]] which emphasized different aspects of both the ''Mandator'' and ''Mandator II'' classes.<ref name="JFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
According to Ansel Hsiao on Stardestroyer.net forums around the time ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'' was released, both he and Jason Fry planned to make all the ''Mandator''-series, in addition to the ''Bellator''-class, humpbacked vessels similar to the one that appeared in ''Dark Empire'', although nothing of the sort made it into the final cut by the time of its release.<ref name="Mandator humpbacked">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1600|text=Something big - Page 65|work=stardestroyer.net|archivedate=20200326203436}}</ref> However, the intended humpbacked hulls of the ''Mandator''-series was nonetheless implied in Jason Fry's endnotes for the book.
